name: ChatGPT (Free, Plus)
tagline: OpenAI's AI chat assistant on personal accounts (Free, Go, Plus, Pro), covered by the consumer privacy policy rather than a business DPA

evidence.quote: OpenAI Ireland Limited, with its registered office at

vendor_entity.note: Controller for users in the EEA or Switzerland. For users elsewhere the controller is OpenAI OpCo, LLC (San Francisco, US), per section 12 of the same policy.

evidence.quote: Dublin 1, D01 YC43, Ireland

vendor_country.note: EEA controller is in Ireland. The non-EEA controller, OpenAI OpCo, LLC, is in the United States.

evidence.quote: intermediate parent is OpenAI Global, LLC (Global), and its ultimate parent is OpenAI, Inc.

parent_company.note: From OpenAI Ireland Limited's abridged financial statements for 2024, filed in the German Bundestag lobby register. Later changes to the group structure were not checked (openai.com/about is blocked).

evidence.quote: both registered and incorporated in the United States with a registered office in San Francisco

parent_country.note: Ultimate parent per OpenAI Ireland Limited's 2024 accounts.

evidence.quote: OpenAI Ireland Limited, with its registered office at

eu_representative.note: The EEA controller is established in Ireland, so an Art. 27 representative is not required for EEA users.

evidence.quote: You can contact our Data Protection Officer at dpo@openai.com

dpo_contact.note: Email contact only; no DPO is named.

evidence.quote: processing and storing your Personal Data in our facilities and servers in the United States

hosting_regions.note: The policy adds that processing can also happen in countries where affiliates, partners, vendors and service providers are located.

evidence.quote: We collect Personal Data that you provide in the input to our Services ("Content"), including your prompts and other content you upload

local_first.note: Prompts and uploads are sent to OpenAI for processing. No local-only mode is described for personal plans.

evidence.quote: OpenAI processes your Personal Data on servers located outside of the EEA, Switzerland and the UK

eu_residency.footnote: Data residency controls are listed only for Enterprise and Edu (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing; see the chatgpt-edu record).
eu_residency.note: Personal-plan data is processed outside the EEA.

cloud_providers.note: Trust portal says 'Hosting Major Cloud Provider' without naming it. Not named on other pages read; openai.com security page blocked.

evidence.quote: We rely on the European Commission's adequacy decisions
we rely on the Standard Contractual Clauses as approved by the European Commission

transfer_mechanism.note: The policy names adequacy decisions and SCCs, not the EU-US Data Privacy Framework. OpenAI's entry on dataprivacyframework.gov was not confirmed (the cached list page does not show entries).

evidence.quote: we disclose Personal Data to vendors and service providers, including providers of hosting services

subprocessors_public.note: The consumer policy lists vendor categories, not named sub-processors. The business list is blocked (source blocked: https://platform.openai.com/subprocessors; also https://openai.com/policies/sub-processor-list/).
subprocessors_public.footnote: For business offerings the DPA points to a Sub-Processor List at platform.openai.com/subprocessors.

subprocessors_count.note: source blocked: https://platform.openai.com/subprocessors (business list). No consumer sub-processor list found, so no count of third-party or group companies is possible.

subprocessors_non_eea.note: source blocked: https://platform.openai.com/subprocessors (business list). No consumer sub-processor list found.

subprocessor_notice.note: The consumer policy only says updated versions are published with an effective date; it does not describe vendor-change notices.
subprocessor_notice.footnote: The business DPA (section 2.9) says OpenAI notifies customers of Sub-Processor List changes, by email if they subscribe.

evidence.quote: This Privacy Policy does not apply to content that we process on behalf of customers of our business offerings

dpa.note: No DPA for personal accounts; OpenAI is controller.
dpa.footnote: Business, Enterprise, Edu and API customers are covered by the OpenAI Data Processing Addendum (see the chatgpt-edu and openai-api records).

evidence.quote: is the controller and is responsible for the processing of your Personal Data

role.note: OpenAI acts as controller for personal-plan content under its own privacy policy.

privacy_policy_date.note: The maintainer-saved copy of the EU privacy policy has no 'last updated' date, and the live page refuses automated reading.

evidence.quote: we will remove it from our systems within 30 days

retention_stated.note: 30 days after you delete data, with longer retention for legal, security and safety reasons (section 4). Temporary Chats are deleted automatically within 30 days.

evidence.quote: Once you choose to delete Personal Data, we will remove it from our systems within 30 days

deletion_on_exit.note: Account deletion is self-service. Exceptions in section 4; content already de-identified for training is not removed.

evidence.quote: You can export your ChatGPT history and data in your account's data controls.

data_export.note: Export is offered; the file format is not stated on pages read.

breach_notice.note: The consumer policy gives no breach-notification window.
breach_notice.footnote: The business DPA says OpenAI will notify the customer 'without undue delay'; it does not cover personal accounts.

evidence.quote: ChatGPT is AI.
how we collect and use training information to develop our language models that power ChatGPT

ai_providers.note: OpenAI runs its own models; no third-party model provider is named.

evidence.quote: we may use Content you provide us to improve our Services, for example to train the models that power ChatGPT
You can easily choose whether your Content can be used to improve and train our models.
Content is used to train our models

trains_on_content.note: The policy explicitly names model training, not only service improvement. The pricing page marks this row 'Opt-out available' for Free, Go, Plus and Pro. Temporary Chats are not used to improve models.
trains_on_content.footnote: Business, Enterprise and Edu: 'No training on your business data by default' (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing; see the chatgpt-edu record).

evidence.quote: Temporary Chats will be automatically deleted within 30 days

ai_zero_retention.note: No zero-data-retention statement for personal plans; content is kept until deleted, and even Temporary Chats are kept up to 30 days.

evidence.quote: Go, Free, and Plus plans are designed to be used by individuals.

ai_admin_off.note: Personal plans have no institution admin.
ai_admin_off.footnote: Business, Enterprise and Edu workspaces have admin controls (see the chatgpt-edu record).

ai_act_statement.note: No EU AI Act statement on pages read; openai.com policy pages are blocked (e.g. source blocked: https://openai.com/policies/eu-terms-of-use/).

evidence.quote: for OpenAI’s API, ChatGPT Enterprise, and ChatGPT Edu services

certifications.note: The ISO 27001/27017/27018/27701 certificate covers the API, ChatGPT Enterprise and Edu; the SOC 2 report covers API, Enterprise, Edu and Team. No certification is stated for personal plans.
certifications.footnote: Enterprise and Edu: ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701 and SOC 2 Type 2 per the trust portal.

evidence.quote: Welcome to our Trust Portal for OpenAI's ChatGPT services, including ChatGPT Enterprise and ChatGPT Edu.

trust_page.note: The portal is written mainly for Enterprise and Edu customers.

evidence.quote: All data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2). Data at rest is encrypted at rest (AES-256)

encryption.note: From the FAQ on the consumer pricing page. Customer-managed keys (EKM) are Enterprise/Edu only per learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing.

pentest.note: A 'Pentest Report' is listed on the trust portal behind 'Get access'; its scope for personal plans is not stated.

evidence.quote: OpenAI invites security researchers, ethical hackers, and technology enthusiasts to report security issues via our Bug Bounty Program.
Contact: https://bugcrowd.com/openai

vuln_disclosure.note: OpenAI-wide bug bounty on Bugcrowd; chatgpt.com also publishes security.txt.

incidents.value: Italian regulator (Garante) decision n. 755 of 2 Nov 2024: EUR 15 million fine for an unreported March 2023 breach and training without legal basis. The Court of Rome (judgment n. 4153/2026, 18 Mar 2026) upheld the appeal against the decision, per the Garante's notice.

evidence.quote: did not notify the Authority of the data breach it underwent in March 2023
sentenza del Tribunale di Roma n. 4153/2026, pubbl. il 18/03/2026

incidents.note: Regulator decision on ChatGPT consumer processing (primary source). The Garante says the decision was temporarily removed from its site after the court ruling; the judgment itself was not read.

evidence.quote: We’re not aware of any issues affecting our systems.

sso.footnote: SAML SSO is offered on Business, Enterprise and Edu (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/pricing).

federation.note: Personal accounts sign in by email, phone or social login. A web search found no OpenAI entry in eduGAIN, SWAMID or InCommon; federation metadata files were not checked directly.

hipaa_baa.note: Not stated for personal accounts on pages read.

state_privacy.note: The US privacy policy is blocked (source blocked: https://openai.com/policies/row-privacy-policy/). The trust portal lists 'CCPA' as a compliance item without scope.
